Hello

I've been trying to fit simple spde model like below

y ~ N(mu, sigma^2)

mu = covariates*beta + GRF

And I have been facing with two issues

1. Underestimated Gaussian precision  
2. Uncertainty measure for the estimated parameter values are all 'zero'.

In fact, the posterior mean of range, kappa, or tau values are similar to the truth - but they all have essentially zero standard deviation.
